summary: First-finish smoke test on VulnOps (FastAPI+Mongo+React). Backend auth, dashboards, findings CRUD, filters/views, assets, products, lists, ingest universal (idempotency + reopen-on-regression + auto-asset), reports CSV/PDF, RBAC admin endpoint, and exception flow all verified working against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend login -> dashboard -> findings -> finding detail -> assets/products/tickets/exceptions/reports/admin nav all render with seeded data. A few minor data-testid mismatches noted (not blocking).
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns {token,user} for admin & analyst
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns admin user object
GET /api/v1/dashboards/analyst returns open_findings=81, kev=39, overdue=70, top_findings, recent_imports
GET /api/v1/dashboards/manager returns by_team, snapshots, active_exceptions
GET /api/v1/dashboards/executive returns current_score=88.7, narrative, snapshots, by_product, by_environment, score_factors
GET /api/v1/findings paginated total=120; filters severity=Critical(48), status=Valid(51), kev=true(60), view=overdue(57), view=kev(60), view=internet_facing_critical(51)
GET /api/v1/findings/{id} returns full document with risk_score and risk_breakdown
GET /api/v1/findings/{id}/timeline|observations|tickets|comments return {items:[...]} payloads (not raw arrays — see note)
POST /api/v1/findings/{id}/comments with body {text:...} adds comment, visible in GET
PATCH /api/v1/findings/{id}/status returns {ok:true} and updates persisted status
POST /api/v1/findings/bulk-status updates multiple (updated=3)
GET /api/v1/assets returns 12 assets with open_findings & critical_findings counts; /assets/{id}/findings works
GET /api/v1/products returns 5 products; /products/{id} returns assets+findings keys
GET /api/v1/engagements(8), /tickets(41), /exceptions(1), /integrations(13), /import-jobs(10) all return items[]
POST /api/v1/exceptions with {finding_id,reason,rationale,expires_at} creates exception and sets finding status='Accepted risk'
POST /api/v1/ingest/universal without X-API-Key -> 401
POST /api/v1/ingest/universal with key & {findings:[{source_tool,source_tool_type,source_record_id,cve,title,severity,asset_hostname,...}]} creates finding+asset+import_job
Idempotency: 2nd identical ingest -> created_count=0, updated_count=1, total findings unchanged
Reopen-on-regression: after setting Fixed validated then re-ingest, status flipped to 'Reopened', reopened_count=1, first_seen_at preserved
Asset auto-created from ingest hostname (assets went 12 -> 13)
GET /api/v1/reports/csv/findings -> 200 text/csv (30KB) with expected header columns
GET /api/v1/reports/pdf/executive -> 200 application/pdf (2.6KB)
GET /api/v1/admin/users -> 200 for admin, 403 for analyst
Frontend: login flow works, sidebar nav renders, Dashboard shows stat tiles (Open=79, Needs triage=10, KEV=37, etc.), Top Risk Findings + Recent Imports populated
Frontend: Findings page loads with table, view-kev tab filter applies, clicking finding row opens detail page with sections + comment input
Frontend nav verified: Findings, Assets, Tickets, Exceptions, Products, Reports, Admin all render with seeded data; Admin table shows Users/RBAC + API keys + SLA policies

failed.issue: data-testid 'nav-import-jobs' not found (sidebar shows 'Import Jobs' link but testid may be 'nav-imports' or similar)
On Reports page, data-testid 'dl-exec-pdf' and 'dl-findings-csv' not found (may be 'export-csv'/'export-exec-pdf' or other names)
failed.evidence: query_selector both returned null on /reports route

failed.issue: Clicking [data-testid="select-all"] did not surface [data-testid="bulk-bar"]; could not validate bulk status change UI in smoke pass
failed.evidence: bulk-bar element not visible after select-all click on /findings

failed.issue: Review spec says timeline/observations/tickets/comments 'return arrays', but they return {items:[...]} dict. Frontend likely consumes .items so this is documentation drift, not a bug.

Ingest payload requires {findings:[{source_tool, source_tool_type, source_record_id, asset_hostname, ...}]} — not the flat top-level shape implied by review spec. Working as designed once correct schema discovered.

action_items: Optional: align data-testids on Reports page (dl-exec-pdf, dl-findings-csv, dl-critical-csv) and Import Jobs sidebar nav (nav-import-jobs) with values listed in problem statement so future automated tests find them.
Investigate bulk-bar visibility on Findings page after select-all click (component may require selecting individual rows, or bulk-bar testid may differ).
